title: Why fail-closed beats silent green
description: A 40-second Short explaining fail-closed checks for agent tools. Educational engineering demo only.

scenes.text: Most dashboards lie with a quiet green check. Fail-closed systems refuse instead.
If evidence is missing, the honest answer is stop — not fake confidence.
Script, voice, visuals, render, then a policy gate with hashes and metrics.
On a laptop without a GPU: TTS plus FFmpeg, offline fixtures, no secret keys required.
Build tools people can verify. Follow for industrial agent skills and MCP trust.
